name: dn-multi-ava-rdn-different-attrs-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees directoryName has a multi-AVA RDN (O=Example+OU=Engineering). The leaf has a multi-AVA RDN at the same position with the same cardinality (two AVAs), but one of them is title instead of OU (O=Example+title=Engineering). The two RDNs share an attribute (O=Example) but differ on the other AVA; RFC 5280 7.1 requires every naming attribute in one RDN to have a matching one in the other, so the RDNs are not equal and the leaf is outside the subtree.
notes: Exercises the case where an implementation matches only on the attribute types it recognises and ignores the differing one.
